# Tools: Credentials and agent identities

Cards for every tool this skill names. Rendered authority: [A] call · [C] confirm first · [O] owner order only.

## Owned

### `list_api_keys` [A] · read · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Lists the caller's own LPM API keys, masked, with profile and status.
Use when: You need keyId for update_api_key or delete_api_key.; Auditing which keys exist, their profile, status and lastUsedAt.; Learning the caller's own userId (field userId).    Avoid when: Workspace owner-agent credentials: use list_workspace_mcp_agent_credentials.; What the current connection can do: use get_mcp_connection_info.
Preconditions: The API key profile is full or custom (sensitive tool).
Returns: JSON array, newest first, of {id, key:'' (always empty), keyPreview ('…' + last 4 chars), name, userId, createdAt, accessProfile, allowedTools (custom only), status (active|revoked), lastUsedAt}.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| -32003 'This API key is not allowed to call MCP tool: <name>' | Sensitive admin tool: only 'full' or 'custom' API keys include it. Call get_mcp_connection_info and tell the user; never try to widen your own key. |
Gotchas:
- Only the caller's keys.
- The secret is never returned.
- Revoked keys are still listed.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors (ChatGPT/Claude); needs an API key.
Pairs with: `update_api_key`, `delete_api_key`

### `create_api_key` [O] · write · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: not idempotent
Purpose: Creates a new LPM API key for the calling user and returns its secret once.
Use when: The account owner explicitly asks for a new key for a named purpose (for example CI or a new agent).    Avoid when: Owner-copilot / roadmap-owner profiles: use create_workspace_mcp_agent_credential.; Changing an existing key: use update_api_key.; Connecting ChatGPT/Claude: they use the OAuth connector, no key needed.
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| name | yes | user | Trimmed; must not be empty. |
| accessProfile | no | constant | enum full\|read-only\|portfolio\|planning\|requirements\|custom. Default and fallback for invalid values: read-only. Prefer read-only or custom; full only on explicit owner instruction. |
| allowedTools | no | constant | Array of exact tool names; used only with accessProfile=custom. Unknown names are dropped silently. |
Preconditions: Explicit instruction from the account owner (credentials are owner-only; never mint keys on your own).; The caller's key is full or custom and includes create_api_key.
Returns: Plain text: 'API key created. ID: <keyId>, Key: <64 hex chars>. PLEASE SAVE THIS KEY AS IT WILL NOT BE SHOWN AGAIN.'
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| 'API key name is required' | Send a non-empty name. |
| 'Owner profiles require a scoped MCP agent credential v2' | Use create_workspace_mcp_agent_credential for roadmap-owner profiles. |
| -32003 'This API key is not allowed to call MCP tool: <name>' | Sensitive admin tool: only 'full' or 'custom' API keys include it. Call get_mcp_connection_info and tell the user; never try to widen your own key. |
Gotchas:
- The key acts as the caller's user with the chosen tool list.
- It is a secret: hand it to the owner once; never log, print in summaries, commit or store it.
- custom with no valid tools gives a key that can call nothing.
- Every call creates another key.
- Clients send it in header x-api-key.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors (ChatGPT/Claude); needs an API key.
Pairs with: `list_api_keys`

### `update_api_key` [O] · destructive · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Changes an API key's access profile and tool list, or revokes/reactivates it.
Use when: The owner asks to narrow or widen a key's permissions.; The owner asks to revoke a key (reversible) or reactivate a revoked key.    Avoid when: Permanent removal: use delete_api_key (prefer revoking here first).; Owner-agent credentials: use update_workspace_mcp_agent_credential_status.
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| keyId | yes | list_api_keys -> id |  |
| accessProfile | no | constant | enum full\|read-only\|portfolio\|planning\|requirements\|custom. Omitted or invalid: keeps the current profile. |
| allowedTools | no | list_api_keys -> allowedTools (edited) | Replaced on every call. If the resulting profile is custom you MUST send the full list, even when only changing status. |
| status | no | constant | enum active\|revoked. Omitted: keeps the current status. |
Preconditions: The key belongs to the caller.; Explicit instruction from the owner.; It is not the key this session uses, unless the user accepts losing access.
Returns: JSON {id, key:'', keyPreview, name, userId, createdAt, accessProfile, allowedTools, status, lastUsedAt}.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| 'API key not found' | Wrong or deleted id; re-read with list_api_keys. |
| 'You do not have access to this API key' | You can only change your own keys. |
| 'Owner profiles require a scoped MCP agent credential v2' | roadmap-owner profiles are not for API keys; use create_workspace_mcp_agent_credential. |
| -32003 'This API key is not allowed to call MCP tool: <name>' | Sensitive admin tool: only 'full' or 'custom' API keys include it. Call get_mcp_connection_info and tell the user; never try to widen your own key. |
Gotchas:
- Omitting allowedTools on a custom key EMPTIES it (the key can call nothing).
- Non-custom profiles clear allowedTools.
- A revoked key gets HTTP 403 'API key is revoked.'; revoking the key you are using locks this session out.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors (ChatGPT/Claude); needs an API key.
Pairs with: `list_api_keys`

### `delete_api_key` [O] · destructive · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: not idempotent
Purpose: Permanently deletes one of the caller's API keys.
Use when: The owner explicitly asks to delete a key (for example leaked or unused).    Avoid when: A reversible cut-off is enough: use update_api_key with status=revoked.

Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| 'API key not found' | Already deleted or wrong id; re-list with list_api_keys. Do not retry blindly. |
| 'You do not have access to this API key' | You can only delete your own keys. |

### `list_workspace_mcp_agent_credentials` [A] · read · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Lists the scoped owner-agent MCP credentials (lpm_mcp_...) of a workspace, masked.
Use when: You need credentialId for update_workspace_mcp_agent_credential_status or rotate_workspace_mcp_agent_credential.; Auditing agent credentials: status, expiresAt, lastUsedAt, useCount.; After a rotation timeout, checking whether a successor already exists (predecessorId).    Avoid when: Personal API keys: use list_api_keys.; Agent identities: use list_workspace_agent_principals.
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id of the workspace. |
Preconditions: The caller is the workspace owner or an active admin.; The API key profile is full or custom.
Returns: JSON array, newest first, of {id, maskedKey, name, workspaceId, principalId, accountableOwnerUserId, accessProfile, allowedTools, usageLimits, status (active|suspended|revoked), notBefore, expiresAt, predecessorId, overlapUntil, lastUsedAt, useCount, createdAt, createdBy}.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| 'You do not have permission to manage this workspace' | Owner/admin only. Ask the workspace owner. |
| -32003 'This API key is not allowed to call MCP tool: <name>' | Sensitive admin tool: only 'full' or 'custom' API keys include it. Call get_mcp_connection_info and tell the user; never try to widen your own key. |
Gotchas:
- Returns [] when the server has credentials v2 disabled: an empty list does not prove none exist.
- status stays 'active' after expiresAt passes, so compare expiresAt with now. Secrets are never returned.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors (ChatGPT/Claude); needs an API key.

### `create_workspace_mcp_agent_credential` [O] · write · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: not idempotent
Purpose: Issues a show-once lpm_mcp_ secret that lets a workspace-owner-copilot agent call a bounded tool set in one workspace on behalf of an accountable owner.
Use when: The workspace owner explicitly asks to issue a credential for an existing workspace-owner-copilot principal.    Avoid when: General-purpose or personal key: use create_api_key.; New secret for an existing credential: use rotate_workspace_mcp_agent_credential.; The principal does not exist yet: create_workspace_agent_principal first.
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id of the workspace. |
| principalId | yes | list_workspace_agent_principals -> id | Format 'agent:<id>'. Principal must be specialistType workspace-owner-copilot and status active. |
| accountableOwnerUserId | yes | list_workspace_agent_principals -> accountableOwnerUserId | Must equal the principal's value and be an active workspace owner/admin (list_workspace_members). |
| accessProfile | yes | list_workspace_agent_principals -> accessProfile | enum roadmap-owner-advisor\|roadmap-owner-operator; must equal the principal's profile. |
| allowedTools | yes | list_workspace_agent_principals -> allowedTools | Non-empty subset of the principal's allowedTools. Unknown names are dropped silently. |
| name | yes | user | Must not be empty. |
| expiresAt | yes | user | ISO 8601 date-time in the future, at most 90 days from now. |
| usageLimits | no | user | Owner decision. Object {modelSynthesisRequestsPerDay (default 50, max 500), deepTechnicalAnalysesPerDay (10, max 100), codeSearchRequestsPerDay (500, max 5000), projectedInputTokensPerDay (600000, max 5000000)}. Missing or invalid -> default; above max -> clamped. |
Preconditions: Explicit instruction from the workspace owner.; The caller is the workspace owner or an active admin.; The server has credentials v2 and the profile enabled (operator also needs the operator flag).; Principal active, type workspace-owner-copilot, same accountable owner and profile.
Returns: JSON masked record {id, maskedKey, status:'active', notBefore, expiresAt, allowedTools, usageLimits, ...} plus secret 'lpm_mcp_<26-char id>.<43-char secret>', shown only once.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| 'You do not have permission to manage this workspace' | Owner/admin only. |
| 'The requested owner-agent profile is disabled by runtime policy' | Server feature flag is off. Tell the owner; do not retry. |
| 'Accountable owner must retain active workspace owner or admin authority' | Pick an owner/admin from list_workspace_members. |
| 'principalId must be a single document ID (no slashes)' / 'Agent principal not found' | Re-read the id from list_workspace_agent_principals. |
| 'Credential, principal, owner, workspace, and profile binding is invalid' | Principal must be workspace-owner-copilot with the same accountableOwnerUserId and accessProfile you sent. |
| 'Credential allowed tools exceed the principal or static profile' | Send a non-empty subset of the principal's allowedTools; principal must be active. |
| 'Credential expiry must be in the future and no more than 90 days' | Fix expiresAt. |
| 'Credential name is required' | Send a name. |
| 'MCP agent credential pepper is not configured' | Server misconfiguration; report to the owner. |
| -32003 'This API key is not allowed to call MCP tool: <name>' | Sensitive admin tool: only 'full' or 'custom' API keys include it. Call get_mcp_connection_info and tell the user; never try to widen your own key. |
Gotchas:
- The secret cannot be recovered: give it to the owner once; never log, print or commit it (evidence may hold only id and maskedKey).
- The agent sends it as 'Authorization: Bearer lpm_mcp_...' (or x-api-key) and acts as the accountable owner inside this workspace only.
- Effective tools = profile preset AND principal.allowedTools AND credential.allowedTools.
- It stops working if the principal is archived or the accountable owner loses owner/admin.
- Every call creates a new credential.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors (ChatGPT/Claude); needs an API key.
Pairs with: `list_workspace_members`, `list_workspace_agent_principals`, `list_workspace_mcp_agent_credentials`
CLI: `lpm mcp-agent-credentials create --workspace <workspaceId> --principal <principalId> --owner <userId> --profile <roadmap-owner-advisor|roadmap-owner-operator> --allowed-tools <tool; tool> --name <text> --expires-at <iso> --show-secret-once [--synthesis-daily <n>] [--deep-analysis-daily <n>] [--code-search-daily <n>] [--input-tokens-daily <n>] [--json]`

### `update_workspace_mcp_agent_credential_status` [O] · destructive · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: not idempotent
Purpose: Suspends, reactivates or permanently revokes an owner-agent MCP credential.
Use when: The owner asks to pause an agent's access (suspended).; The owner asks to resume a suspended credential (active).; A credential leaked or is retired (revoked).    Avoid when: Replacing the secret while keeping access: use rotate_workspace_mcp_agent_credential.; Personal API keys: use update_api_key.
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id of the workspace. |
| credentialId | yes | list_workspace_mcp_agent_credentials -> id |  |
| status | yes | constant | enum active\|suspended\|revoked. Allowed: active->suspended\|revoked, suspended->active\|revoked. revoked is final. |
Preconditions: Explicit instruction from the workspace owner.; The caller is the workspace owner or an active admin.; The credential belongs to this workspace and the transition is allowed.
Returns: JSON masked credential record with the new status.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| 'MCP agent credential not found' | Re-read the id with list_workspace_mcp_agent_credentials. |
| 'MCP agent credential is outside this workspace' | Use the credential's own workspaceId. |
| 'Invalid credential lifecycle transition from <a> to <b>' | Read the current status. Already at target: nothing to do. revoked cannot change: issue a new credential. |
| 'You do not have permission to manage this workspace' | Owner/admin only. |
| -32003 'This API key is not allowed to call MCP tool: <name>' | Sensitive admin tool: only 'full' or 'custom' API keys include it. Call get_mcp_connection_info and tell the user; never try to widen your own key. |
Gotchas:
- revoked is permanent (the CLI requires --confirm for it).
- Reactivating does not extend expiresAt: an expired credential stays unusable.
- Each change writes an audit event.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors (ChatGPT/Claude); needs an API key.
Pairs with: `list_workspace_mcp_agent_credentials`
CLI: `lpm mcp-agent-credentials status --workspace <workspaceId> --credential <credentialId> --status <active|suspended|revoked> [--confirm] [--json]`

### `rotate_workspace_mcp_agent_credential` [O] · destructive · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: not idempotent
Purpose: Issues a new secret for an owner-agent credential and makes the old one expire after a short overlap.
Use when: The owner asks for a scheduled rotation, or the secret may be exposed but the agent needs a brief overlap.; The credential is near expiresAt and the owner wants continuity.    Avoid when: Leaked secret with no need for overlap: update_workspace_mcp_agent_credential_status revoked, then create a new credential.; Different tools or profile: create_workspace_mcp_agent_credential (rotation copies everything).
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id of the workspace. |
| credentialId | yes | list_workspace_mcp_agent_credentials -> id | Use the newest credential of the chain (one that no other credential lists as predecessorId). |
| expiresAt | yes | user | ISO 8601 for the NEW credential; in the future, at most 90 days ahead. |
| overlapMinutes | no | constant | Integer 0-15, default 10. The old secret keeps working until now + overlap. |
Preconditions: Explicit instruction from the workspace owner.; The caller is the workspace owner or an active admin.; Credential is active or suspended and in this workspace.; Its principal still exists and is active with the same scope, and the accountable owner is still owner/admin.
Returns: JSON new masked record (new id, status 'active') + secret (shown once) + predecessor {id, expiresAt, overlapUntil}.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| 'MCP agent credential not found' | Re-read the id with list_workspace_mcp_agent_credentials. |
| 'Only an active or suspended credential in this workspace can rotate' | Revoked credentials cannot rotate; create a new one. |
| 'Credential expiry must be in the future and no more than 90 days' | Fix expiresAt. |
| 'Rotation overlap must be between 0 and 15 minutes' | Send an integer 0-15. |
| 'Credential binding is no longer valid' / 'Credential scope is no longer valid' | Principal is gone/archived/changed or the owner lost admin. Create a new principal or credential with the owner. |
| 'The requested owner-agent profile is disabled by runtime policy' | Server feature flag is off; tell the owner. |
| -32003 'This API key is not allowed to call MCP tool: <name>' | Sensitive admin tool: only 'full' or 'custom' API keys include it. Call get_mcp_connection_info and tell the user; never try to widen your own key. |
Gotchas:
- The old secret stops at overlapUntil: update the agent's configuration inside that window.
- The new credential is ACTIVE even if the old one was suspended, so rotation re-enables access.
- Rotating the same credential twice creates two live successors: after a timeout, look for predecessorId in list_workspace_mcp_agent_credentials before retrying.
- Secret shown once; never log it.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors (ChatGPT/Claude); needs an API key.
Pairs with: `list_workspace_mcp_agent_credentials`
CLI: `lpm mcp-agent-credentials rotate --workspace <workspaceId> --credential <credentialId> --expires-at <iso> --show-secret-once [--overlap-minutes <0..15>] [--json]`

Purpose: Lists the registered agent identities (specialist reviewers/advisors and workspace owner copilots) of a workspace.

### `create_workspace_agent_principal` [O] · write · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: not idempotent
Purpose: Registers a versioned agent identity (specialist reviewer/advisor or workspace owner copilot) in a workspace with explicit authority restrictions and no human governance authority.
Use when: The owner asks to register a specialist agent so it can be assigned to projects (create_project_specialist_assignment).; The owner asks to set up a workspace-owner-copilot before issuing its MCP credential.    Avoid when: Editing an existing principal's metadata: use update_workspace_agent_principal.; New type, mode, version or profile for an existing principal: archive it (update_workspace_agent_principal status=archived), then create a new one.; Issuing a secret: use create_workspace_mcp_agent_credential.
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id of the workspace. |
| displayName | yes | user | Must not be empty. |
| description | no | user |  |
| specialistType | yes | constant | enum risk-reviewer\|architecture-reviewer\|data-steward-advisor\|security-reviewer\|privacy-advisor\|records-management-reviewer\|accessibility-reviewer\|operations-reviewer\|ai-risk-reviewer\|tenant-isolation-reviewer\|workspace-owner-copilot. |
| mode | yes | constant | enum advisor\|reviewer\|executor. executor only for workspace-owner-copilot; a copilot cannot be reviewer. |
| version | yes | user | Non-empty, e.g. '1.0.0'. |
| providerRef | no | user | Descriptive label; model choice is the owner's decision. |
| modelRef | no | user | Descriptive label; model choice is the owner's decision. |
| accessProfile | no | constant | Copilot: 'roadmap-owner-advisor' with mode advisor, 'roadmap-owner-operator' with mode executor (required). Specialists: read-only (default), full, portfolio, planning or requirements; they only ever get read tools. |
| capabilities | no | user | Array of free-text capability tags. |
| allowedTools | no | constant | Copilot: REQUIRED non-empty subset of its profile's tools. Specialists: list of read tool names; empty means no tools in assignments. |
| accountableOwnerUserId | no | list_workspace_members -> userId | REQUIRED for workspace-owner-copilot: a human owner/admin, never an 'agent:' id. |
| authorityRestrictions | yes | user | Non-empty array of plain-language limits, e.g. 'no scope approval', 'no budget changes'. |
Preconditions: Explicit instruction from the workspace owner.; The caller is the workspace owner or an active admin.; A principal for the same purpose does not already exist (list_workspace_agent_principals).
Returns: JSON principal record with id 'agent:<random>' and status 'active'.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| 'You do not have permission to manage this workspace' | Owner/admin only. |
| 'Specialist agent type is invalid' / 'Specialist agent operating mode is invalid' | Use the enum values listed in inputs. |
| 'Agent principal display name is required' / 'Agent principal version is required' / 'Agent principal authority restrictions are required' | Send the missing field (non-empty). |
| 'Workspace owner copilot requires an accountable human owner' | Send accountableOwnerUserId of a human owner/admin. |
| 'Workspace owner copilot mode and access profile do not match' | advisor + roadmap-owner-advisor, or executor + roadmap-owner-operator. |
| 'Workspace owner copilot allowed tools must be a non-empty subset of its static profile' | Send allowedTools chosen only from that profile's tools. |
| 'Executor specialists require an explicit per-tool allowlist and are not enabled' | Use mode advisor or reviewer for specialist types. |
Gotchas:
- Every call creates a new principal.
- specialistType, mode, version and accessProfile cannot be changed later.
- Principals never get human governance authority (cannot approve scope or budgets).
- Each creation writes an audit event.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors (ChatGPT/Claude); needs an API key.
Pairs with: `list_workspace_members`, `list_workspace_agent_principals`, `create_workspace_mcp_agent_credential`, `create_project_specialist_assignment`

### `update_workspace_agent_principal` [O] · destructive · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Edits the mutable metadata of an agent principal, or archives it permanently.
Use when: The owner asks to change displayName, description, providerRef, modelRef, capabilities or authorityRestrictions.; The owner asks to retire an agent (status=archived).    Avoid when: Changing specialistType, mode, version or accessProfile: archive this one and create_workspace_agent_principal.; Stopping only one credential: use update_workspace_mcp_agent_credential_status.
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id of the workspace. |
| agentPrincipalId | yes | list_workspace_agent_principals -> id | Format 'agent:<id>'. |
| displayName | no | user | Must stay non-empty. |
| description | no | user |  |
| providerRef | no | user | Label only; model choice is the owner's decision. |
| modelRef | no | user | Label only; model choice is the owner's decision. |
| capabilities | no | user | Replaces the whole array. |
| authorityRestrictions | no | user | Replaces the whole array; must stay non-empty. |
| status | no | constant | enum active\|archived. archived is final. |
Preconditions: Explicit instruction from the workspace owner.; The caller is the workspace owner or an active admin.; The principal exists and is active (archived principals are immutable).
Returns: JSON full updated principal record.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| 'Agent principal not found' | Re-read the id with list_workspace_agent_principals. |
| 'Archived agent principals are immutable' | Create a new principal instead. |
| 'Agent principal authority restrictions are required' / 'Agent principal display name is required' | Do not send empty values for these fields. |
| 'You do not have permission to manage this workspace' | Owner/admin only. |
Gotchas:
- Archiving is permanent (archived principals are immutable, server.ts:17981) and immediately disables every MCP credential bound to the principal.
- Arrays are replaced, not merged.
- The schema does not expose allowedTools/accountableOwnerUserId (the server accepts them); changing them can break existing credentials ('Credential scope is no longer valid'), so prefer a new principal.
- Each change writes an audit event.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors (ChatGPT/Claude); needs an API key.
Pairs with: `list_workspace_agent_principals`

| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id of the workspace. |
Preconditions: The caller is the workspace owner or an active member.; The API key profile is full or custom (sensitive tool).
Returns: JSON array of {provider (gemini|openai|anthropic), workspaceId, keyPreview (first 4 + '••••' + last 4), label, createdAt, updatedAt, updatedBy}. The key itself is never returned.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| -32003 'You do not have permission to manage or view credentials in this workspace.' | Caller is not a member of this workspace (or wrong id). Re-check list_workspaces; ask the owner. |
| -32003 'This API key is not allowed to call MCP tool: <name>' | Sensitive admin tool: only 'full' or 'custom' API keys include it. Call get_mcp_connection_info and tell the user; never try to widen your own key. |
Gotchas:
- One entry per provider at most.
- An empty array means no workspace keys; Gemini features can still work if the server runs Gemini on Vertex.
- Do not paste keyPreview into public places.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors (ChatGPT/Claude); needs an API key.
Pairs with: `list_workspaces`, `get_workspace_ai_config`, `list_workspace_ai_provider_models`

### `upsert_workspace_ai_credential` [O] · write · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Stores (encrypted) or replaces the workspace API key for one AI provider.
Use when: The workspace owner explicitly asks to set or replace the key for gemini, openai or anthropic and provides it.    Avoid when: Choosing default provider/model, enabling AI or changing budgets: use update_workspace_ai_config (owner decision).; GitHub token: use upsert_workspace_repository_credential.; Only checking what exists: use list_workspace_ai_credentials.
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id of the workspace. |
| provider | yes | constant | enum gemini\|openai\|anthropic. |
| apiKey | yes | user | Secret. Trimmed, must not be empty. Never echo, log or store it; prefer that the owner types it in LPM Settings instead of the chat. |
| label | no | user | Free text shown in listings. |
Preconditions: Explicit instruction from the workspace owner (credentials are owner-only).; The caller is the workspace owner or an active admin.; The API key profile is full or custom.
Returns: Plain text: 'Workspace AI credential <provider> saved successfully.'
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| -32003 'You do not have permission to manage or view credentials in this workspace.' | Caller is not owner/admin. Ask the workspace owner to do it. |
| 'AI API key is required' | Ask the owner for the key; do not invent one. |
| 'Unsupported AI provider.' | Use gemini, openai or anthropic. |
| 'Credential operation could not be completed. Check access and configuration, then retry.' | Generic failure (e.g. server encryption not configured). Report to the owner; do not loop. |
| -32003 'This API key is not allowed to call MCP tool: <name>' | Sensitive admin tool: only 'full' or 'custom' API keys include it. Call get_mcp_connection_info and tell the user; never try to widen your own key. |
Gotchas:
- Silently overwrites the existing key for that provider.
- The key is NOT tested on save: confirm it with list_workspace_ai_provider_models.
- Saving a key does not change which provider/model the workspace uses.
- Never put the key in comments, commits, evidence or summaries.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors (ChatGPT/Claude); needs an API key.
Pairs with: `list_workspace_ai_credentials`, `list_workspace_ai_provider_models`, `get_workspace_ai_config`

### `delete_workspace_ai_credential` [O] · destructive · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Deletes the stored workspace API key for one AI provider.
Use when: The workspace owner explicitly asks to remove a provider key (for example leaked or retired).    Avoid when: Replacing the key: use upsert_workspace_ai_credential (no gap in service).; Turning AI off: use update_workspace_ai_config (owner decision).
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id of the workspace. |
| provider | yes | constant | enum gemini\|openai\|anthropic. |
Preconditions: Explicit instruction from the workspace owner.; The caller is the workspace owner or an active admin.; Owner knows whether this provider is the workspace default (get_workspace_ai_config): AI features on it will stop.
Returns: Plain text: 'Workspace AI credential <provider> deleted successfully.' (also when nothing was stored).
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| -32003 'You do not have permission to manage or view credentials in this workspace.' | Caller is not owner/admin. Ask the workspace owner. |
| 'Unsupported AI provider.' | Use gemini, openai or anthropic. |
| -32003 'This API key is not allowed to call MCP tool: <name>' | Sensitive admin tool: only 'full' or 'custom' API keys include it. Call get_mcp_connection_info and tell the user; never try to widen your own key. |
Gotchas:
- No undo: the key must be provided again.
- Afterwards AI features on that provider fail with '<Provider> API key is not configured for this workspace.' Deleting in LPM does not revoke the key at the provider; if it leaked, tell the owner to revoke it there too.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors (ChatGPT/Claude); needs an API key.
Pairs with: `get_workspace_ai_config`, `list_workspace_ai_credentials`

### `get_workspace_repository_credential` [A] · read · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Show whether a workspace GitHub token is configured (status, revision, dates) without ever returning the token.
Use when: Before upsert_workspace_repository_credential or delete_workspace_repository_credential, to get expectedRevision; Diagnosing 'Workspace GitHub credential unavailable or access denied.' from a scan with credentialSource=workspace    Avoid when: Checking your personal GitHub credential or the GitHub App: get_project_repository_context / get_workspace_repository_context (userCredential, connector)
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,160} |
Preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner or an active member
Returns: {id:'github', provider:'github', workspaceId, status (active|revoked|absent), configured, revision (0 when absent), createdAt, updatedAt, validatedAt}
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| You do not have permission to manage or view credentials in this workspace. | Caller is not a member; tell the user. |
| Credential configuration could not be read. | Stored record is invalid; report to the user. |
| Workspace, token or expected credential revision is invalid. | Check the workspaceId format. |
Gotchas:
- This vault token is used ONLY by scans with credentialSource=workspace; code indexing, search, excerpts and commit comparison never use it.
Pairs with: `upsert_workspace_repository_credential`, `delete_workspace_repository_credential`, `scan_workspace_repository_readonly`
CLI: `lpm workspace-github get --workspace <workspaceId> [--json]`

### `upsert_workspace_repository_credential` [O] · write · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: not idempotent
Purpose: Validate a GitHub token against GitHub and store it encrypted as the workspace's repository credential (create or rotate).
Use when: The workspace owner/admin explicitly instructs you to set or rotate the workspace GitHub token and supplies it through a safe channel (environment variable)    Avoid when: On your own initiative: never; credentials are owner decisions; Fixing private-repository code indexing or search: this vault is not used there (needs the GitHub App or the link creator's personal credential); Removing the token: delete_workspace_repository_credential
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id |
| token | yes | user (owner), via environment variable | GitHub token, 20-8192 chars, no whitespace. Never echo, log or paste it in chat |
| expectedRevision | yes | get_workspace_repository_credential -> revision | Integer >= 0; 0 when no credential exists |
Preconditions: Explicit instruction from the workspace owner/admin; Caller is workspace owner or admin (full/custom API key); expectedRevision equals the current revision; Fewer than 5 validation attempts in the last hour for this workspace and for this user; Token is accepted by GitHub (/user)
Returns: Credential summary: status 'active', configured true, revision = expectedRevision + 1, validatedAt. Never the token.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Credential changed. Reload the current configuration and retry. | Re-read get_workspace_repository_credential; if the revision moved because your earlier call succeeded, do not repeat. |
| GitHub credential validation rate limit exceeded. Try again later. | Wait one hour; tell the user. |
| GitHub credential validation failed. Check the token and retry. | Token invalid or expired; ask the owner for a new one. |
| Workspace, token or expected credential revision is invalid. | Check token length/whitespace and that expectedRevision is a non-negative integer. |
| You do not have permission to manage or view credentials in this workspace. | Only workspace owner/admin can set it. |
Gotchas:
- Never print the token; prefer the CLI, which reads it from an environment variable and never echoes errors.
- Every attempt, even a failed one, uses the 5/hour validation budget.
Pairs with: `get_workspace_repository_credential`, `scan_workspace_repository_readonly`
CLI: `lpm workspace-github set --workspace <workspaceId> --expected-revision <n> --token-env <ENV_NAME> --confirm [--json]`

### `delete_workspace_repository_credential` [O] · destructive · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: not idempotent
Purpose: Erase the workspace's stored GitHub token in LPM (status revoked); the token itself stays valid at GitHub.
Use when: The workspace owner/admin explicitly asks to remove the workspace GitHub token (suspected leak, offboarding)    Avoid when: Rotating the token: upsert_workspace_repository_credential with the new token; Revoking at GitHub: the owner must do it in GitHub settings
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id |
| expectedRevision | yes | get_workspace_repository_credential -> revision | Integer >= 0; must equal the current revision |
Preconditions: Explicit instruction from the workspace owner/admin; Caller is workspace owner or admin (full/custom API key); expectedRevision equals the current revision
Returns: Credential summary with status 'revoked', configured false, revision + 1 (when already revoked or absent, the current summary is returned unchanged).
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Credential changed. Reload the current configuration and retry. | Re-read get_workspace_repository_credential; if status is already revoked, you are done. |
| You do not have permission to manage or view credentials in this workspace. | Only workspace owner/admin can remove it. |
| Workspace, token or expected credential revision is invalid. | expectedRevision must be a non-negative integer. |
Gotchas:
- Does NOT revoke the token at GitHub; if it leaked, tell the owner to revoke it there.
- Afterwards, scans with credentialSource=workspace fail with 'Workspace GitHub credential unavailable or access denied.'
Pairs with: `get_workspace_repository_credential`
CLI: `lpm workspace-github remove --workspace <workspaceId> --expected-revision <n> --confirm [--json]`

### `list_project_specialist_assignments` [A] · read · KEY · profiles: full, read-only, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Lists every specialist-agent assignment of a project (active and revoked), most recently updated first.
Use when: Find the assignmentId before revoking an assignment.; See which specialist agents work on the project, under which accountable human, scope and authority boundary.; Check for an existing assignment before creating a new one (avoid duplicates).    Avoid when: Only effective coverage counts are needed -> get_project_specialist_governance_summary.; You need the agent principals themselves (type, mode, status) -> list_workspace_agent_principals.
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| projectId | yes | list_projects -> id (or list_workspace_projects -> id; get_workspace_decision_inbox -> items[].projectId) | Firestore project id. |
Preconditions: Project exists and caller can read it (project owner, any project governance role, workspace member or team member).; API-key connection (no OAuth scope).
Returns: Array of assignments {id, workspaceId, projectId, agentPrincipalId, specialistType, mode, accountableUserId, scopeStatement, authorityBoundary, conflictDeclaration, independentFromAgentId, requirementId, issueId, governanceThreadId, validFrom, validUntil, reviewCadence, reviewTriggers[], lastRunAt, nextReviewAt, status:'active'|'revoked', createdBy, createdAt, updatedBy, updatedAt, revokedBy, revokedAt}.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Project <id> not found | Re-read the id from list_projects; do not guess ids. |
| You do not have access to this project | Wrong project or credential; call get_mcp_connection_info and confirm the workspace the key/connector can reach. |
| Tool missing from the tool list (OAuth connector) | Not exposed to OAuth connectors; needs an API-key connection. Call get_mcp_connection_info and tell the user. |
Gotchas:
- Includes revoked rows: filter status=='active' and check validFrom/validUntil yourself (or use the summary tool for the effective count). No pagination.
Pairs with: `list_projects`, `revoke_project_specialist_assignment`, `get_project_specialist_governance_summary`

### `create_project_specialist_assignment` [O] · write · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: not idempotent
Purpose: Assigns a registered workspace specialist agent principal to a project under a named accountable human, with a scope statement and an authority boundary.
Use when: The owner explicitly asked to put a specialist reviewer/advisor agent (risk, security, privacy, architecture...) on a project.; Replacing an assignment: after revoke_project_specialist_assignment, create the corrected one (there is no update tool).    Avoid when: The agent principal does not exist yet -> create_workspace_agent_principal first (also an owner decision).; An active assignment for the same principal already exists -> list_project_specialist_assignments and reuse it.; Giving a human a project governance role -> not this tool; assignments never grant human authority.
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| projectId | yes | list_projects -> id (or list_workspace_projects -> id; get_workspace_decision_inbox -> items[].projectId) | Firestore project id. |
| agentPrincipalId | yes | list_workspace_agent_principals -> id | Format 'agent:<id>'. Must be active and in the project's workspace. Advisor/reviewer modes only (executor only exists for workspace-owner-copilot). |
| accountableUserId | yes | list_workspace_members -> userId (as chosen by the owner) | A human user id with read access to the project; never an 'agent:' id. |
| scopeStatement | yes | user | Non-empty: what the specialist covers on this project. |
| authorityBoundary | yes | user | Non-empty: what the specialist may and may not do (e.g. 'advise only, no approvals'). |
| conflictDeclaration | no | user | Free text. |
| independentFromAgentId | no | list_workspace_agent_principals -> id | Must differ from agentPrincipalId. |
| requirementId | no | list_requirements -> id | Stored as-is; existence not checked. |
| issueId | no | list_issues -> id | Stored as-is; existence not checked. |
| governanceThreadId | no | list_governance_threads -> items[].id | Stored as-is; existence not checked. |
| validFrom | no | user | ISO 8601; default = now. |
| validUntil | no | user | ISO 8601, must be later than validFrom; omit for open-ended. |
| reviewCadence | no | constant | enum on-demand\|monthly\|quarterly\|release-gate; default quarterly. |
| reviewTriggers | no | constant | array of strings; default ['baseline-change','release-gate','material-risk']. |
Preconditions: Explicit owner instruction (this delegates governance scope to an agent).; Caller can MANAGE the project (project owner, project-owner role, workspace or team manager).; Project belongs to a workspace; the principal is active in that same workspace.; API-key profile full or custom (administration write tools are in no other preset); not exposed to OAuth connectors.
Returns: The created assignment {id, workspaceId, projectId, agentPrincipalId, specialistType, mode, accountableUserId, scopeStatement, authorityBoundary, conflictDeclaration, independentFromAgentId, requirementId, issueId, governanceThreadId, validFrom, validUntil, reviewCadence, reviewTriggers[], lastRunAt, nextReviewAt, status:'active'|'revoked', createdBy, createdAt, updatedBy, updatedAt, revokedBy, revokedAt} with status 'active'; specialistType and mode are copied from the principal. Keep id for revoke.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| You do not have permission to manage this project | Caller cannot manage the project; ask the project owner to do it. |
| Agent principal not found in project workspace | Use an id from list_workspace_agent_principals for the project's workspace. |
| Accountable user must have access to the project | Pick a human who can read the project (list_workspace_members) and confirm with the owner. |
| A human accountable user is required | accountableUserId was empty or an 'agent:' id; use a human userId. |
| Assignment scope statement is required / Assignment authority boundary is required | Ask the owner for the missing text; do not invent it. |
| Archived agent principal cannot receive assignments | Principal is archived; the owner must pick or create another principal. |
| Assignment validity window is invalid | Send ISO 8601 dates with validUntil later than validFrom. |
| An agent cannot be independent from itself | independentFromAgentId must be a different principal. |
| Project workspace is required | Project has no workspace; assignments are not possible there. |
| Tool missing from the tool list (OAuth connector) | Not exposed to OAuth connectors; needs an API-key connection. Call get_mcp_connection_info and tell the user. |
Gotchas:
- Not idempotent: every call creates another assignment, even for the same principal; list first.
- No update tool: to change scope or dates, revoke and recreate.
- An assignment never grants human authority (summary always reports humanAuthorityStillRequired=true). Writes an audit event.
Pairs with: `list_workspace_agent_principals`, `list_workspace_members`, `list_project_specialist_assignments`, `get_project_specialist_governance_summary`

### `revoke_project_specialist_assignment` [O] · destructive · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Permanently revokes a project specialist assignment (status active -> revoked); a revoked assignment can never be reactivated.
Use when: The owner explicitly asked to remove a specialist agent from a project.; An assignment has the wrong scope/accountable human and the owner wants it replaced (revoke, then create a new one).    Avoid when: A temporary pause is wanted -> no pause exists; tell the owner revoke is permanent and a new assignment would be needed later.; Retire the agent everywhere -> update_workspace_agent_principal (status archived), an owner decision.
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| projectId | yes | list_projects -> id (or list_workspace_projects -> id; get_workspace_decision_inbox -> items[].projectId) | Firestore project id. |
| assignmentId | yes | list_project_specialist_assignments -> id | Assignment of the same project. |
Preconditions: Explicit owner instruction; confirm the exact assignment (principal, accountable user) before calling.; Caller can MANAGE the project.; API-key profile full or custom; not exposed to OAuth connectors.
Returns: The updated assignment {id, workspaceId, projectId, agentPrincipalId, specialistType, mode, accountableUserId, scopeStatement, authorityBoundary, conflictDeclaration, independentFromAgentId, requirementId, issueId, governanceThreadId, validFrom, validUntil, reviewCadence, reviewTriggers[], lastRunAt, nextReviewAt, status:'active'|'revoked', createdBy, createdAt, updatedBy, updatedAt, revokedBy, revokedAt} with status 'revoked', revokedBy and revokedAt set.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Specialist assignment not found | Re-read assignmentId with list_project_specialist_assignments for the same projectId. |
| You do not have permission to manage this project | Ask the project owner to revoke it. |
| Invalid assignment lifecycle transition from <x> to revoked | Stored status is unexpected; stop and report to the owner. |
| Tool missing from the tool list (OAuth connector) | Not exposed to OAuth connectors; needs an API-key connection. Call get_mcp_connection_info and tell the user. |
Gotchas:
- Irreversible.
- Calling it on an already revoked assignment succeeds but overwrites revokedAt/revokedBy and writes another audit event, so check status first.
Pairs with: `list_project_specialist_assignments`, `get_project_specialist_governance_summary`, `create_project_specialist_assignment`

### `get_project_specialist_governance_summary` [A] · read · KEY · profiles: full, read-only, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Summarizes a project's effective specialist-agent coverage and grounded review runs, always stating that human authority is still required.
Use when: Quick check whether a project has any effective specialist reviewer and whether agents have reviewed it.; Owner asks for specialist coverage, findings count or overdue reviews of a project.    Avoid when: You need the individual assignments or an assignmentId -> list_project_specialist_assignments.; Workspace executive roles -> list_missing_governance_assignments.
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| projectId | yes | list_projects -> id (or list_workspace_projects -> id; get_workspace_decision_inbox -> items[].projectId) | Firestore project id. |
Preconditions: Project exists and caller can read it (project owner, any project governance role, workspace member or team member).; Caller can also read the project's WORKSPACE (principals are listed at workspace level).; API-key connection (no OAuth scope).
Returns: {projectId, workspaceId, generatedAt, principalCount, assignmentCount, effectiveAssignmentCount, accountableUserCount, specialistTypes[], reviewState:'agent-reviewed'|'unreviewed', latestGroundedRunAt, findingCount, overdueReviewCount, humanAuthorityStillRequired:true}
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Project <id> not found | Re-read the id from list_projects; do not guess ids. |
| You do not have access to this project | Wrong project or credential; call get_mcp_connection_info and confirm the workspace the key/connector can reach. |
| You do not have access to this workspace | Caller has project/team access but not workspace access; use list_project_specialist_assignments instead. |
| Tool missing from the tool list (OAuth connector) | Not exposed to OAuth connectors; needs an API-key connection. Call get_mcp_connection_info and tell the user. |
Gotchas:
- Effective = assignment active + principal active + now inside validFrom/validUntil + type/mode still match the principal.
- reviewState 'agent-reviewed' is never human approval.
- overdueReviewCount relies on nextReviewAt, which creation leaves null, so it is usually 0.
Pairs with: `list_projects`, `list_project_specialist_assignments`

## Used here (owned by another skill; rules live there)

### `get_mcp_connection_info` [A] · read · workspace:read · owner `lpm-start` · profiles: full, read-only, portfolio, planning, requirements, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Describes the caller's own MCP connection: credential type, granted scopes or tool count, workspace reach, and how to unlock missing tools.
Use when: FIRST call when an expected tool is missing or a call returns -32003 (access denied).; The user asks what this connector can do or which permissions it has.; Before telling the user a feature is unavailable.    Avoid when: Workspace details: use get_workspace.; Managing your API keys: use list_api_keys.
Preconditions: Any authenticated connection (OAuth or API key).
Returns: OAuth: {credential:'oauth', scopes[], workspaceAccess (single|all), workspaceId (only when single), connectorRegisteredAt, accessTokenExpiresAt, availableToolCount, unavailableToolGroups[{scope, title, optional, tools[], howToEnable}]}. API key: {credential:'api_key', allowedToolCount, workspaceId:null, howToChange}.
Gotchas:
- howToEnable is Portuguese text for the end user: relay it as is.
- On ChatGPT, disconnect/connect does NOT re-run OAuth or refresh the tool list: the connector must be removed and reinstalled and the optional box ticked (e.g. 'Gestão de atividades dos projetos' = portfolio:manage).
- For API keys the allowed tools are set on the key by its owner (update_api_key). Returns no tokens.
- Owner-agent credentials (lpm_mcp_...) cannot call it: it is not in the roadmap-owner profile tool lists.
- 'lpm mcp status' only counts tools.
Pairs with: `list_workspaces`

### `list_workspaces` [A] · read · workspace:read · owner `lpm-start` · profiles: full, read-only, portfolio, planning, requirements, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Lists the workspaces the caller can reach, to obtain workspaceId.
Use when: First step of almost any task: find the workspaceId by name.; Checking whether you can manage a workspace (API key: access.canManage).    Avoid when: You already have the workspaceId and need its details: use get_workspace.; You need the projects: use list_workspace_projects or list_projects.
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| teamId | no | list_teams -> id | API key only; OAuth rejects it as unknown_field. |
| status | no | constant | active \| archived. |
| compact | no | constant | true returns only id, name, key, status, teamId, ownerId, createdAt, updatedAt (drops access.canManage). |
| limit | no | constant | Max number returned. OAuth: integer 1-100. |
Preconditions: OAuth: scope workspace:read.
Returns: API key: array (newest first) of workspace records {id, name, slug, description, status, ownerId, teamId, createdAt, updatedAt, access:{canManage}}. OAuth: [{id, name}] of authorized active workspaces only.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| OAuth -32602 invalid_arguments (unknown_field teamId, or limit out of range) | Under OAuth send only status, compact, limit (1-100). |
| -32003 access denied | Call get_mcp_connection_info to see the connection's scopes. |
Gotchas:
- access.canManage=true (owner/admin) is required for update_workspace, delete_workspace_issue_link and update_workspace_ai_config.
- With an API key the list also includes workspaces where you only own a project; get_workspace may then deny access.
- OAuth: status 'archived' always returns [] and a single-workspace grant returns only that workspace.
- Use compact:true to save context only when you do not need canManage.
Pairs with: `get_mcp_connection_info`, `get_workspace`, `list_workspace_projects`

### `list_projects` [A] · read · portfolio:read · owner `lpm-start` · profiles: full, read-only, portfolio, planning, requirements, roadmap-owner-advisor, roadmap-owner-operator, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Lists the projects the caller can see (as owner, workspace member or team member), optionally filtered by workspace or team; archived projects are hidden unless includeArchived=true.
Use when: You need a projectId and only know the project name or key; User asks which projects exist in a workspace or team; Start of a session, to pick the project to work on    Avoid when: You already have the projectId: use get_project; You need the open work of a project: use get_project_execution_context; You need the workspace view of its projects with workspace context: list_workspace_projects is equivalent for one workspace
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | no | list_workspaces -> id | Optional with an API key but REQUIRED under OAuth (ChatGPT/Claude connectors). With a workspace agent credential it defaults to the credential's workspace and any other value is rejected. |
| teamId | no | list_teams -> id | Exact-match filter. |
| includeArchived | no | constant | Boolean, default false. Set true to find archived projects (e.g. before unarchive_project). |
Preconditions: Under OAuth the workspaceId must be a workspace included in the grant
Returns: JSON array of full project documents: id, name, key, description, ownerId, workspaceId, teamId, archived, createdAt and, when set, governanceAssignments, routingProfile, hourlyRate. Use id as projectId in every project-scoped tool.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| -32602 This project listing requires an explicit workspaceId. (OAuth) | Call list_workspaces, take the id of the right workspace, retry with workspaceId. |
| -32003 The requested resource is outside the credential scope | You passed a workspaceId other than the agent credential's workspace; omit workspaceId. |
| Empty array | Check workspaceId/teamId, retry with includeArchived=true; if still empty the caller has no access. Ask the user; never guess IDs. |
Gotchas:
- No pagination: returns every matching project.
- A project where the caller only holds a governance role (not owner, not workspace/team member) is NOT listed, although get_project works for it.
- Without workspaceId (API key) the server scans all projects, so pass workspaceId when known.
- Match the user's project by name or key; never guess an ID.
Pairs with: `list_workspaces`, `get_project`, `get_project_execution_context`, `list_issues`
CLI: `lpm projects list [--workspace-id <id>] [--team-id <id>] [--include-archived] [--json]`

### `list_workspace_members` [A] · read · workspace:read · owner `lpm-workspace-admin` · profiles: full, read-only, portfolio, planning, requirements, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Lists the members of a workspace with their roles.
Use when: You need the userId, email or role of people in a workspace.; You must confirm the caller is owner/admin before using admin tools.; Choosing accountableOwnerUserId (role owner/admin) for agent principals or credentials.; Before add_workspace_member, to avoid adding someone twice.    Avoid when: Who can be assigned activities in one project: use list_project_assignable_members.; Team members: use list_team_members.
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | On a single-workspace OAuth grant it may be omitted; the grant fills it in. |
Preconditions: The caller is the workspace owner or an active member.
Returns: JSON array of {id (= userId), workspaceId, userId, userEmail, role (owner|admin|member|viewer), status, createdAt, updatedAt}.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| -32602 'You do not have access to this workspace' | Wrong workspaceId or caller is not a member; re-check list_workspaces. |
| OAuth -32003 access denied | Workspace is outside the grant; call get_mcp_connection_info. |
Gotchas:
- The owner is also stored in the workspace document (get_workspace -> ownerId) and keeps full rights from it.
- Only owner/admin can manage (WORKSPACE_ADMIN_ROLES); member and viewer are read-only. No pagination.
Pairs with: `list_workspaces`, `get_user`, `add_workspace_member`, `remove_workspace_member`

### `get_workspace_ai_config` [A] · read · KEY · owner `lpm-ai-cost` · profiles: full, read-only, portfolio, planning, requirements, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Returns a workspace's effective AI policy: on/off, providers, model per operation, feature flags and usage limits (AI budget).
Use when: Diagnosing Advisor fallbackReason ai_disabled, ai_usage_limit_reached or ai_provider_unavailable.; Reporting the current model or budget to the owner.; Mandatory read before any update_workspace_ai_config.    Avoid when: You need which provider keys are stored: use list_workspace_ai_credentials.; You need the models a provider offers: use list_workspace_ai_provider_models.
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id |  |
Preconditions: The caller is the workspace owner or an active member.
Returns: {workspaceId, enabled, defaultProvider, allowedProviders[], models{embedding, requirementsDocumentAnalysis, operationalEntrySuggestion}, featureFlags{embeddings, requirementsDocumentAnalysis, operationalEntrySuggestion}, usageLimits{dailyTokenBudget, monthlyTokenBudget, dailyRequestLimit}, createdAt, updatedAt, updatedBy, source:'workspace'|'default'}.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| 'You do not have access to this workspace' | You are not a member; ask the owner. |
Gotchas:
- models.requirementsDocumentAnalysis is also the Advisor answer model (answer_project_question, roadmap questions), and featureFlags.requirementsDocumentAnalysis=false turns the Advisor off.
- source='default' means nothing is stored and server defaults apply.
- A null usage limit means no limit.
- Shows limits, not consumption.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors.
Pairs with: `list_workspaces`, `list_workspace_ai_credentials`, `list_workspace_ai_provider_models`

### `list_workspace_ai_provider_models` [A] · read · KEY · owner `lpm-ai-cost` · profiles: full, read-only, portfolio, planning, requirements, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Lists the models a provider offers for one AI operation, using the workspace's stored credential.
Use when: The owner asks which models are available before choosing one.; Validating a model id before the owner-approved update_workspace_ai_config.    Avoid when: You need the models currently configured: use get_workspace_ai_config.
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id |  |
| provider | yes | constant | gemini \| openai \| anthropic. |
| operation | yes | constant | embedding \| requirementsDocumentAnalysis (also the Advisor model) \| operationalEntrySuggestion. |
Preconditions: The caller is the workspace owner or an active member.; A credential for the provider is stored (list_workspace_ai_credentials), unless Gemini runs on the server's Vertex backend.
Returns: {workspaceId, provider, operation, source:'live'|'unavailable', unavailableReason, models:[{id, displayName, provider, operation, isRecommended, isPreview, isDeprecated, supportsOperation}]}. Use models[].id as a model value.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| 'Unsupported AI provider: <x>' / 'Unsupported workspace AI model operation: <x>' | Use exactly the enum values. |
| 'You do not have access to this workspace' | Ask the owner for membership. |
| Provider API error | Retry later; do not change the config because of it. |
Gotchas:
- A missing credential is NOT an error: source='unavailable', models=[] and unavailableReason explains why.
- Fetches the provider's model list (live API, or the built-in Vertex list when the server runs Gemini on Vertex), cached 5 minutes per workspace/provider/operation.
- Listing changes nothing; choosing a model is the owner's decision.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors.
Pairs with: `get_workspace_ai_config`, `list_workspace_ai_credentials`, `update_workspace_ai_config`
